text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, sauce ramen it is. I need to 
recover from the race quickly, and—"

text_block_list.name: TV Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Believe it or not, we're here at Tracen 
Academy today! Let's get up close and 
uncover the secrets of the girls who light 
up the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Manager. I'll come visit 
your shop again another time."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... Right now, I just need to run. I 
have to show the Central... what I'm made 
of.

Looking worn out from the race, Furioso 
headed toward the training grounds. I'll 
need to reconsider her upcoming racing 
schedule...
